The row's track should be Research, not C++. The Swiss C++ seat is in Zug, not Geneva: https://www.squarepoint-capital.com/open-opportunities?id=612873&gh_jid=612873

Paris appears only on research and support reqs: Junior Quant Researcher (id=239376), Junior Quant Researcher - ML Alpha Research (id=6069464), the five Senior Quant Researcher reqs, Intern Quant Researcher, Junior Commodities Fundamental Analyst, Junior Credit Fundamental Research Analyst, and Support Analyst - Desktop. The row's claim that Paris is a 'first-class engineering site' with the 'highest-probability top-20 seat' is not supported by the board — Paris is a research site for Squarepoint.

London is also the deepest C++ site — Junior Software Developer (C++) (id=6040731), Software Developer - Data Infrastructure (id=4992227), Risk Technology (id=6212106) and Order Gateway (id=609831) are all open there too.

notes:
Board and method: Squarepoint's own careers pages (https://www.squarepoint-capital.com/open-opportunities and /early-careers) are JavaScript-rendered and returned only boilerplate text to a fetch — no job listings. The listings are served by Squarepoint's own Greenhouse board under the token 'squarepointcapital', which I read directly via boards-api.greenhouse.io. That is the firm's own hosted board and the canonical apply URLs it returns point back to squarepoint-capital.com, so I have marked these verified-primary. Note that /careers 404s; the correct path is /open-opportunities. All 89 live reqs were enumerated on 2026-08-04.

Offices: the /locations page lists exactly 18 offices — Bangalore, Boston, Chicago, Dubai, Geneva, Hong Kong, Houston, Jersey, London, Los Angeles, Madrid, Milan, Montreal, New York, Paris, Singapore, Warsaw, Zug. There is NO Tokyo, Shanghai, Amsterdam, Dublin, Frankfurt or Zurich office. Milan and Jersey exist as offices but have zero live in-scope reqs (Jersey appears only on two accounting reqs, Milan on none at all). Zurich does not exist as a Squarepoint office — the Swiss sites are Geneva and Zug.

Row shape: several Squarepoint reqs are single postings covering many cities. Rather than duplicate a row per city, each role below carries a comma-separated list of the IN-SCOPE cities on that req; out-of-scope cities on the same req are named in the notes field. Split these per city if the spreadsheet needs one row per location.

ML Performance track: Squarepoint has NO GPU, kernel, HPC or ML-infrastructure engineering openings anywhere. I checked all 89 titles. The nearest adjacency is Junior Quant Researcher - ML Alpha Research, which is a research seat asking for Python and kdb-q rather than performance engineering. This is a genuine gap for this candidate at this firm — the C++ track is where the fit is.

Compensation: Squarepoint publishes minimum base salary only for New York roles (USD 100k for Graduate Software Developer, USD 150k for the research reqs), a US pay-transparency artifact. No figures are stated for any in-scope office, so comp_local is empty except where I have quoted the NY number with an explicit caveat. The existing spreadsheet's local comp ranges (CHF 130-190k, EUR 85-130k, GBP 110-170k, SGD 200-300k) are not sourced from anything Squarepoint publishes and I could not verify them.

Application process: nearly every posting opens with 'Please only apply to the one job you feel best fits your skillset and experience. If our team feels you are better suited for another role, we will reach out about the alternate opportunity.' This matters — the candidate gets one shot and should pick deliberately. On this profile the best pick is Junior Software Developer (C++) in London or Singapore, with Junior Quant Researcher - ML Alpha Research as the research-track alternative if the publication record is the stronger card. Several 2026-vintage reqs also now require 'demonstrable experience using AI tools collaboratively' as a stated qualification.

No visa or work-authorisation language appears in any posting body. No Mandarin requirement appears on the Hong Kong reqs.
